channel.title: Dinner at Tiffani's
channel.desc: It's Mardi Gras at Tiffani's, and she's got her take on the bayou for Bill Bellamy and his wife Kristen and Eric Close; hot crab and kale dip with Creole crostini, plus Tiffani's take on gumbo, a Sazerac cocktail, cheesy grits with blackened butter.
